chunks: And from him, from several of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Musa, from Ali ibn Ja'far, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Touch/Press the Rukn (the corner of the Kaaba), for it is the Hand of Allah among His creation; it shakes hands with His creation with the handshake of a servant or a guest, and it bears witness for whoever touches it with fidelity/completeness.'

key_terms.الرُّكْنُ: The Rukn (corner), specifically the Yemeni Corner of the Kaaba

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of touching the Rukn al-Ya'man during Hajj or Umrah?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the Rukn al-Ya'man as a locus of divine greeting, where the act of Istilam (touching/kissing) is viewed as a personal salutation from Allah to the pilgrim. The mention of bearing witness to 'muwafat' (faithfulness/completion) underscores the corner's role not merely as a ritual marker but as a spiritual witness to the pilgrim's sincerity and fulfillment of their covenant with God.
